variables.rooms: {% set ns = namespace(l=[]) %}{% for b in states.input_boolean | selectattr('entity_id', 'match', '^input_boolean\.sleeping_') %}{% set a = area_id(b.entity_id) %}{% set sw = (area_entities(a) | select('match', '^switch\.magic_areas_light_groups_.+_light_control$') | list) if a else [] %}{% if sw %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + [[sw[0] | replace('switch.magic_areas_light_groups_', '') | replace('_light_control', ''), states(sw[0]), b.state == 'on']] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.l }}
variables.stored: {% set s = states('input_text.sleeping_paused') %}{{ [] if s in ['unknown', 'unavailable', 'none', ''] else s.split(',') | reject('eq', '') | list }}

variables.pause: {% set ns = namespace(l=[]) %}{% for r in rooms %}{% if r[2] and r[1] == 'on' %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + [r[0]] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.l }}
variables.release: {% set ns = namespace(l=[]) %}{% for s in stored %}{% set m = namespace(asleep=false) %}{% for r in rooms %}{% if r[0] == s and r[2] %}{% set m.asleep = true %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if not m.asleep %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + [s] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.l }}

variables.handoff: {% if away_now %}{% set s = states('input_text.house_away_paused') %}{% set have = [] if s in ['unknown', 'unavailable', 'none', ''] else s.split(',') | reject('eq', '') | list %}{{ (have + release) | unique | list }}{% else %}{{ [] }}{% endif %}
variables.keep: {{ ((stored | reject('in', release) | list) + pause) | unique | list }}

target.entity_id: {% set have = states.switch | map(attribute='entity_id') | list %}{{ release | map('regex_replace', '^(.*)$', 'switch.magic_areas_light_groups_\\1_light_control') | select('in', have) | list }}

description: 2026-11-27 (operator: 'the lights might turn on as well while people are sleeping'). While a room's input_boolean.sleeping_<room> is on, its Magic Areas light_control is off, so movement in bed does not light the room. Only rooms whose presence lighting was ON are paused, and they are remembered in input_text.sleeping_paused (area slugs) so a restart loses nothing; clearing the toggle (by hand or at noon) releases only those. A room released while the house is Away is handed to input_text.house_away_paused instead, so Away's return restores it. If another automation (Away's return) switches a sleeping room's presence lighting back on, it is paused again; a PERSON switching it on is left alone until the next toggle change. The room's switch is found by area, so no list to keep. Tests: tests/climate/cases.py (sleeping lights). Design: docs/presence-lighting.md.
